question: what japanese-vietnamese dataset do they use?

evidence: We collected Japanese-Vietnamese parallel data from TED talks extracted from WIT3's corpus BIBREF15 . After removing blank and duplicate lines we obtained 106758 pairs of sentences. The validation set used in all experiments is dev2010 and the test set is tst2010.

title: Combining Advanced Methods in Japanese-Vietnamese Neural Machine Translation
answer_short: TED talks extracted from WIT3's corpus
answer_rationale: The document explicitly states in Text 43 (page 9, section=Data Preparation) that the Japanese-Vietnamese parallel data was collected from TED talks extracted from WIT3's corpus. This is the only source mentioned for the dataset used in the study.
